label: Generar Release .deb y .tar.gz (Linux)
command: cmake -B build-release -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-release && cd build-release && cpack

label: Configurar CMake (Windows)
command: $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module "$vsPath\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsPath -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64"; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build-win -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmake -S . -B build-win -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-windows; (Get-Content build-win\build.ninja) -replace 'build build\.ninja: RERUN_CMAKE', 'build build.ninja.disabled: RERUN_CMAKE' | Set-Content build-win\build.ninja

label: Compilar y Ejecutar (Windows)
command: $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module "$vsPath\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsPath -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64"; (Get-Content build-win\build.ninja) -replace 'build build\.ninja: RERUN_CMAKE', 'build build.ninja.disabled: RERUN_CMAKE' | Set-Content build-win\build.ninja; ninja -C build-win FronterMind; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $env:PATH = "C:\Qt\6.12.0\msvc2022_64\bin;$PWD\build-win;$env:PATH"; .\build-win\FronterMind.exe }

label: Generar Release Portable .zip (Windows)
command: $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module "$vsPath\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsPath -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64"; cmake -S . -B build-win-release -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-windows; (Get-Content build-win-release\build.ninja) -replace 'build build\.ninja: RERUN_CMAKE', 'build build.ninja.disabled: RERUN_CMAKE' | Set-Content build-win-release\build.ninja; ninja -C build-win-release FronterMind; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist-win -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist-win | Out-Null; Copy-Item .\build-win-release\FronterMind.exe dist-win\; Copy-Item .\build-win-release\*.dll dist-win\ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; C:\Qt\6.12.0\msvc2022_64\bin\windeployqt.exe --release --qmldir src/ui/qml dist-win\FronterMind.exe; Compress-Archive -Path dist-win\* -DestinationPath FronterMind-v0.1.0-Windows-x64.zip -Force
